answer: In Proof of Agent, sybil resistance makes coordinated equivocation economically self-defeating: when k bonded identities submit conflicting attestations, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), so pairwise evidence compounds across the swarm. Detection triggers an exponential multiplier in aggregate capital loss, amplified by escrow seizure and asymmetric depreciation. Thus an operator cannot safely wander beyond the protocol’s horizon or hide a sybil grove behind nominally independent keys.
